subject: Commercial readiness: Clarus Health — procurement & hosting preference
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@clarushealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial readiness: Clarus Health — procurement & hosting preference

Hi Emily — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment on procurement readiness and recommended hosting path before you start the paperwork: 

Key takeaways from today's demo and procurement signals:
- Clarus wants a production-safe inference stack for clinical note summarization and triage routing.
- Primary preference is low-latency; they asked about both Hosted API and Dedicated options.
- Procurement team tends to prefer PO-based purchasing but they can accept credit card for < $10k monthly.
- Marketplace listings (Azure/AWS) would help their internal procurement, but they need commercial terms standardized for SSO and data retention.

Open questions I promised to confirm:
1) Which hosting route do you prefer as your default: Hosted (fast onboarding), Dedicated (reserved capacity + SLA), or Private (VPC/on-prem)? If you're undecided, tell me the priority order (latency vs. isolation vs. cost).
2) Is the buyer on the call (Adam) the person who will sign the PO? If not, who is the contract owner and their timeline?
3) Do you require marketplace procurement (Azure Marketplace/AWS Marketplace) for compliance reasons, or is a direct PO to Redwood acceptable?
4) Any hard constraints on billing cadence (monthly vs. annual) or minimum commit?

Attached: initial pricing sheet (hosted / dedicated / private rows) and a draft SOW stub that maps to your early usage assumptions. These are starting points — we can adapt commits and term length to fit your procurement rules.

Next steps:
- Emily to confirm questions 1–4 above by end of week so we can scope final commercial proposal.
- I will loop in pricing/contract (Karthik and Laura) once you confirm hosting preference and PO ownership.
- Tentative timeline: finalize commercial paperwork in 2–3 weeks if procurement signals are green.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick sync with Adam and your procurement lead if helpful.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0189
[Attachment: Redwood_pricing_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)]
[Attachment: SOW_Clarus_draft.pdf (pdf, 85KB)]

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@clarushealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Adam Weiss <procurement@clarushealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial readiness: Clarus Health — procurement & hosting preference

Mina — thanks for the clear recap and the materials. A few answers from my side: 

1) Hosting priority: Dedicated > Hosted > Private. Latency is critical for the triage feature; we want predictable p99 targets.
2) Adam is the procurement owner and will sign the PO. I'll confirm his target approver list (legal + finance) by tomorrow.
3) Marketplace: we would prefer Azure Marketplace if listing is available; procurement gets approvals faster that way. That said, a direct PO is acceptable if Marketplace takes too long.
4) Billing cadence: monthly invoicing is preferred. We can consider a 6–12 month commit if the discounts are significant — need to see numbers.

Adam, do you want to join a call with Mina/Karthik next week to walk through the PO process and attach any vendor forms?

Thanks,
Emily
Sr. Product Manager, Clinical Automation
Emily.Zhang@clarushealth.com

Mina / Emily — I can take point on the PO. A few procurement items for Redwood to confirm so we can move quickly:
- Vendor onboarding: do you have a standard W-9 + vendor form? Please attach or link to your vendor portal.
- Do you support Master Services Agreement + Statement of Work (MSA + SOW) or do you prefer a single contract? We typically push for an MSA.
- Invoice delivery: we need PDF invoices emailed to finance@clarushealth.com and a purchase order number on each invoice.
- Azure Marketplace: If you can provide a marketplace listing ID or partner registration, that's preferred; otherwise we'll process a direct PO.

If possible, send the W-9 and sample MSA. I'll schedule a 30-min session next Wednesday to walk through vendor forms with our legal/finance team.

Regards,
Adam Weiss
Procurement Manager | Clarus Health
procurement@clarushealth.com

Hi Karthik & Laura — forwarding the thread and Emily / Adam's notes. Ask: can you review the attached pricing and recommend a committed cadence that meets their request for 'predictable p99 latency' (Dedicated preferred) while keeping discounts palatable if they go marketplace vs direct PO?

Specific guidance requested:
- Recommended SKU: Dedicated medium pool (4xA10G equivalent) vs Dedicated large (8xA10G equivalent) — which gives better latency headroom for the triage workload?
- Commit structure: 6-month vs 12-month commit examples (monthly invoice) and discount thresholds.
- Marketplace delta: any differences in pricing or contract terms if they purchase via Azure Marketplace vs a direct PO?

I've tentatively scheduled the vendor/forms call for next Wed 10:30am PT; please confirm availability so I can include you both on the invite.

Thanks — Mina
